The '''Fiviune system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Fiviune]].
